senses.gloss: केत् केत्, i. 10, Par., see कित्.

केत केत, i. e. कित् + अ, m.
 1. Desire (ved.).
 2. An abode, Bhāg. P. 2, 7, 12.
 3. An image, 1, 16, 34.
केतक केत + क, m. The name of a tree, Pandanus odoratissimus, Rām. 2, 94, 6.

केतन केतन, i. e. कित् + अन, n.
 1. Invitation, Man. 4, 110.
 2. An abode, MBh. 3, 13396.
 3. A place, Kathās. 26, 44.
 4. A sign, MBh. 14, 2430.
 --Comp.

केतु केतु, i. e. कित् + उ, m.
 1. A sign by which an object may be recognised, [] Chr. 289, 3 = Rigv. i. 50, 3; Chr. 294, 1 = Rigv. i. 92, 1; Rām. 2, 54, 5.
 2. A banner, MBh. 4, 2068.
 3. Chief, Rām. 4, 28, 18.
 4. A meteor, Man. 1, 38.
 5. The mythological name of the descending node, represented as a headless demon, Rām. 3, 35, 52.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Goth. haidus; A.S. had.

केतुमन्त् केतु + मन्त्, m.
 1. The name of a Dānava, or demon, MBh. 1, 2532.
 2. The name of a palace, Hariv. 8989.

केतु- + माल केतु- + माल,
 I. m. 1. pl. the name of a people, Hariv. 8227. 2. the name of a वर्ष or division of the earth, Bhāg. P. 5, 2, 19.
 II. f. ला, the name of a holy place, MBh. 3, 8368.
केतु- + यष्टि केतु- + यष्टि, m. a flag-staff. Ragh. 12, 103.
